comments.body:
This is caused by broken behavior in DXC's overload resolution. We have a bunch of related issues that will need to be addressed in order to support [this planned fix for HLSL 202x](https://github.com/microsoft/hlsl-specs/blob/main/proposals/0007-const-instance-methods.md).

That feature is effectively going to result in us adopting C++ overload rules completely for HLSL, which should solve this and related issues.
@llvm-beanz did you disable `operator=` overloading too? its still in an example in the wiki
